negativeChecks: zero selected entries -> typed REPAIR.CLOSED_WORLD_NOT_ESTABLISHED, not a KeyError
five-member projection supplied where the seven-member record is required -> refuse at admission
two disagreeing selected entries -> not applicable, both reasons carried
two agreeing selected entries -> repairPlanId equal to the single-entry Run's
a dissenting entry in a universe no target reaches -> does NOT defeat the plan (keeps the gate target-relative)
a dissenting entry for a relation no requirement names -> decide explicitly; recommend does NOT defeat, recorded as a choice the law makes
preserved: apply-time security authorization bound to the exact repairPlanId, base snapshot and project
current source identity versions: run3, subject3, coverage2, scope2, repairplan2, descriptor schemaMajor 1 (workflows:repair) and 2 (evaluator3)
the closed public detail code registry
dynamicDispatch target-relative and never a global veto
tradeoffs: conjunction can make a multi-universe plan inapplicable that an arbitrary pick would allow; intended for a universal negative, but it is a behaviour change for such implementations, and no change for single-entry Runs
target-relative selection adds a target -> subject3 -> universe join to a Query-class operation and one more preview failure route (unresolvable subject3 -> existing REPAIR.EVIDENCE_RUN_UNAVAILABLE)
law-only moves no schema byte and no identity; the disclosure sibling makes the gate auditable from the plan alone but is a schema edit and a new parity surface. Take law-only first
scoping to the requirement's relations keeps the gate target-relative; scoping to all relations is simpler to state but re-creates a global veto through the back door
